_comment: Coding tool set for the E33.2 Agentic/Local run (ai-project-system P10-M33-E33.2) executing local-agent-runner Epic P3-M4-E4.1 (CF-2 public run API). allow_paths uses an absolute-path glob (tools.py path_permitted() fnmatchcase()s against Path.resolve()'s absolute output, so a relative './**' never matches) — '*/local-agent-runner/**' matches this repo by directory name on any host, plus '/workspace/**' for the sandbox mount.
